indicators.note: obstreperous means noisy and unruly, so these letters run riot into a new order

explanation.surface: A boisterous rhinoceros is, in fact, out of touch with reality.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Obstreperous' looks like a description of the rhino but signals that the thirteen letters of RHINO ACTUALLY are rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone delusional sees things that are not there, the hallmark of a hallucination-like state.

definitions.meaning: Wolverhampton Wanderers, an English football club, are nicknamed this
a cryptic hint at the animals that hunt together in packs

explanation.surface: Which football side plays as one tight unit?
explanation.walkthrough: Wolverhampton Wanderers are an English football club known by this nickname; the second reading is the animals themselves, which live in packs.
explanation.definitionFit: Both readings apply: a club nickname and the pack-hunting canines of the wild.

clue.text: Clergyman's office finds odd bits of clue exciting

indicators.note: the odd-numbered letters, first and third, of the word clue are taken

explanation.surface: A churchman's post turns out to be found by thrilling fragments of a crossword clue.
explanation.walkthrough: 'odd bits of' takes the first and third letters of 'clue', C and U.
explanation.definitionFit: A curate's position or tenure, the post held by an assistant priest, is the office named.

definitions.meaning: something brilliant that shines in the night sky
a famous person, especially a performer

explanation.surface: An exclamation that something dazzling is a famous name.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a shining heavenly body, the other a famous performer or personality.

clue.text: Drug dealer quick to hide abuse

indicators.note: one word conceals another inside it, so the abuse sits within the word for quick

explanation.surface: A fast narcotics trafficker conceals mistreatment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Drug dealer' suggests a criminal, but a chemist's shop legitimately deals in drugs.
explanation.definitionFit: A chemist's shop dispenses and sells medicines, so it is literally a dealer in drugs.

clue.text: Provide food for two sorts of queen?

parts.note: a queen is a female cat
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the crossword abbreviation for the Queen

explanation.surface: Serving meals to a pair of royals, perhaps.
explanation.walkthrough: The one word 'queen' gives two kinds: CAT, since a queen is a female cat, and ER, Elizabeth Regina.
explanation.definitionFit: To cater is to supply meals, the work of a caterer at an event.

definitions.meaning: to bury is to ..., put a body in a grave

explanation.surface: Bury, the English town and club, set against a famous Italian side.
explanation.walkthrough: Bury is also an English town with a football club, which makes the clue look like a fixture.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is to lay a body in a grave; the other is the short name of Internazionale of Milan.

clue.text: One way to cook a steak? Congratulations!

definitions.text: One way to cook a steak?
definitions.meaning: a steak cooked right through, no pink left

explanation.surface: A diner's order followed by praise for the chef.
explanation.definitionFit: Steak cooked thoroughly is ordered this way, and the same phrase is said to praise success.

definitions.meaning: a quick light kiss on the cheek

explanation.surface: Should one give Gregory a kiss?
explanation.definitionFit: A light quick kiss is a peck, and Gregory Peck was a Hollywood actor, an example of the surname.

indicators.note: something tricky is twisted and awkward, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A difficult game appears inside a puzzle.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tricky' signals that GAME IN is rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A riddle or mystery is a puzzle, something baffling to be solved.

parts.note: the Dee is a river in Scotland and another in Wales and England
a jay is a bird of the crow family

explanation.surface: A bird on the river turns out to be a musician.
explanation.definitionFit: A disc jockey spins records at a club or on radio; the spelt-out initials give this form.

clue.text: Drat! The refuse could be cleaner!

indicators.note: the letters could be made into something else, a hint to rearrange them

explanation.surface: An exasperated householder curses the rubbish, wishing it were tidier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could be' signals rearranging DRAT THE REFUSE; 'cleaner' reads as an adjective but is a noun, a cleaning tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A plume of feathers on a stick is used to clear dust, so it is a household cleaning tool.

indicators.note: off means gone wrong or awry, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Something drifts away up into the sky.
explanation.definitionFit: Up high, overhead, is the sense: something held overhead is up in the sky.

clue.text: Leggy young runner needing permit to box still

indicators.note: to box is to enclose in a container, so the word for permit encloses the word for still

explanation.surface: A long-limbed young athlete needs a licence to keep boxing.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'young runner' is not an athlete but an animal: a young hare.
explanation.definitionFit: A young hare, long-legged and fast, is a leggy young runner.

clue.text: Greek island very cold, looking north

indicators.note: in a down clue, facing north means read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: A Greek island is freezing and faces north.
explanation.definitionFit: Kos, also spelt this way, is a Greek island in the Dodecanese.

indicators.note: mixed means jumbled together, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A whole tin of fruit cocktail.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixed' signals rearranging ENTIRE CAN; 'mixed fruit' looks like one phrase but splits.
explanation.definitionFit: A smooth-skinned variety of peach is a fruit.

clue.text: Short digit about right to play the guitar, say?

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the shortened digit goes round the letter for right
short means cut down, so the word for digit loses its last letter

parts.note: a thumb is a digit of the hand

explanation.surface: A short finger wrapped round the right hand strums a guitar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' cuts THUMB to THUM, which goes 'about' R.
explanation.definitionFit: To strum or pluck strings idly, as on a guitar, is to thrum; 'say' marks the guitar as one example.

clue.text: Fast vehicle going up or down

definitions.note: a car built for speed on a racing circuit, read here as the word itself

indicators.note: in a down clue, the word reads the same whether read upwards or downwards

parts.note: a car built for speed on a racing circuit, read here as the word itself

explanation.surface: A speedy motor heads uphill or downhill.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up or down' says the entry reads the same both ways in the grid.
explanation.definitionFit: A car built for motor racing is a fast vehicle.

clue.text: Part of a newspaper covering crime for clerical residence

indicators.note: covering means wrapping round, so the newspaper part surrounds the crime

parts.note: a page is one part of a newspaper
arson is the crime of deliberately setting fire to property

explanation.surface: A newspaper report on a crime at a vicarage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'covering' looks like journalistic reporting of the crime, but it means wrapping round.
explanation.definitionFit: A house provided for a parson, a parish priest, is a clerical residence.

indicators.note: in means placed inside, so the props go inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
leans means props, as in props against

explanation.surface: Using church props to purify the place.
explanation.walkthrough: CE is the Church of England; 'props' is a verb, rests against.
explanation.definitionFit: To purify is to make clean, removing anything impure.

clue.text: Wearing only pyjama bottoms, perhaps, slept so badly

indicators.note: badly means poorly done, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone sleeping in just pyjama trousers had a poor night.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone in only pyjama trousers has a bare chest, with nothing on the upper body.

definitions.meaning: a lamp you carry in the hand

explanation.surface: Is a torch easy to carry?
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a lamp or flame giving illumination; the other means weighing little.

parts.note: a rave is a large dance party

explanation.surface: Longing for a Tory social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: To long for something intensely is to yearn, an exact synonym.

definitions.note: pop is an informal name for one's father, and the same word for father is spelt identically both ways

indicators.note: the clue says outright the word reads the same backwards and forwards

parts.note: pop is an informal name for one's father, and the same word for father is spelt identically both ways

explanation.surface: Pointing out that a word for father reads the same both ways, like pop itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Pop is an informal word for father, as is this word.
